title: Bus and truck drivers from third countries
description:
Please note that this is not a call for tenders but a publication announcing the Contracting authority’s intention to publish a future negotiated low or middle valueprocedure. 
All EU countries are affected by an acute shortage of bus and truck drivers. Professional bus and truck drivers in the EU need to have a certificate of professional competence (CPC). In accordance with Directive (EU) 2022/2561, drivers from 3rd countries obtain the necessary qualification in the Member State where the undertaking employing them is established or in the Member State that issued a work permit to them – often by having to follow 280 hours courses and by passing a test. This project contains three tasks: (1) A survey among competent national authorities and other relevant stakeholders in Member States is to be carried out to find out about best practices regarding the employment of third-country drivers; (2) The study looks at the requirements to obtain a driver CPC in 25 third countries each for truck and for bus drivers (12 non-EEA ECMT countries (for truck drivers), 10 non-EU Contracting Parties of the Interbus Agreement (for bus drivers), the 7 countries participating in the EU Talent Partnership Programme and other countries at the choice of the tenderer), compares them with the requirements in the EU in accordance with Directive (EU) 2022/2561 and identifies the missing elements. (3) Towards the end of the project, a workshop will be organised in Brussels where the results of the project will be presented to a wider public. Participation in this call for tenders is also open on equal terms to natural and legal persons established in a third country.

title: IOD Camera SpaceMast
description: Aim of procurement is the successful purchase of a hosted IOD-Mission (In-Orbit-Demonstration), as a hosted payload service, including launch and launch services with a well-established launcher system, as well as mission operation with a well-established host spacecraft/OTV, both featuring flight heritage and a successful mission history. The underlying goal is to gain flight heritage of the SpaceMast system and the demonstration of featured functionalities in real space environment. The host spacecraft/OTV shall be able to change orbits and altitudes, provide power, data up and down-link, and control in terms of activating the Camera SpaceMast system, as an OTV (orbital transfer vehicle) would do. Payload Description: The payload “Camera SpaceMast System” shall be flown in a hosted configuration and can be considered roughly as a block volume with rectangular dimensions. The system consists of five major components: 1. The Stationary Mast Deployment Unit with included mechanisms, 2. the Deployable Composite Mast, 3. the Camera Box, housing camera and electronics, 4. the electrical Drive Motor operating the mechanisms 5. and the Electronics Compartment The main function of the Camera SpaceMast system is to deploy its camera several meters away from the host spacecraft/OTV/OTV and taking images or videos of it or other payloads, from a wider view angle. This is achieved by deploying the Deployable Composite Mast, as the Camera Box is mounted to its tip. A second function is the retraction of mast and camera. The Deployable Composite Mast itself is flattened and rolled up for stowage, and pushed out of the Stationary Mast Deployment Unit, vice versa for deployment. The mast and therefore the camera box can be retracted and re-deployed multiple times. Actuation of deployment and retraction is driven by an electrical motor and controlled by the Electronics Compartment. Additionally, the overall system features several sensors for monitoring, that are integrated at different locations. Further information can be found in the attached Specification of Services (contract documents).

title: Voluntary Ex-Ante Transparency Notice - ESRI ArcGIS
description: Like other TSOs and utility companies, TenneT TSO B.V. and TenneT TSO GmbH use ArcGIS software from the Environmental Systems Research Institute, Inc. (“ESRI”), Redlands, California, USA and/or ESRI Nederland B.V. as a geographic information system (GIS). This ArcGIS software consists of several parts and these parts together form the ArcGIS platform. The ArcGIS platform has been in use at TenneT TSO for more than 10 years. The ArcGIS platform offers all the functionality to integrate maps and spatial analyzes into TenneT's business systems, dashboards and reporting systems. At TenneT TSO there is a need to continue working with the current GIS system. The existing GIS system is based on the ESRI ArcGIS software, which is supplied by the same party. ESRI has exclusive rights that are not licensed to others, so that even for reasons of exclusive rights (including intellectual property rights such as copyright, database law, trademark law and protection of know-how) no other party can provide the software and services as described. Due to the technical reasons stated here, we conclude that competition is absent. For this reason and due to the fact that these exclusive rights must be protected, the negotiated procedure without prior call for competition was chosen in accordance with article 3.36 of the Dutch Public Procurement Act (“Aanbestedingswet 2012”). If an alternative system has to be used (insofar as a comparable system is present), a completely new GIS environment would have to be built, which would involve substantial additional costs and substantial divestments. In addition, any alternative system presents disproportionate technical difficulties when using and maintaining the equipment, including the software. ESRI ArcGIS software is also used within TenneT's OneBMR harmonization project. The products within this project have been tendered according to the legal procedure and are expected to go into production in mid-2023. Before entering into the agreement (which includes licenses, associated maintenance & support and advice) with ESRI, TenneT TSO will give market parties the opportunity to object to this decision within 20 calendar days, calculated from the date of publication. The final date to act against this decision is therefore September 7th 2022. You may lodge an objection against the intended award decision by sending an email to Bob Goosen (bob.goosen@tennet.eu) up to twenty days after publication of this notice and after expiry of this period you will forfeit any right to lodge an objection against this decision.

description: § 130a Absatz 8 SGB V ermöglicht den Krankenkassen und pharmazeutischen Unternehmen, Rahmenrabattverträge über die zu Lasten der gesetzlichen Krankenkassen abzugebenden Arzneimittel zuschließen. description: De WIBON verplicht Evides om haar infrastructuur vast te leggen in een geografisch informatiesysteem (GIS). Dit GIS is binnen Evides bekend als ESRI ArcGIS. Evides zal voor 1 januari 2028 alle huidige circa 220.000 aansluitleidingen in haar Zeeuwse voorzieningsgebied(telling Q2-2024) moeten vectoriseren en vastleggen zodat voldaan wordt aan de WIBON. Aanvullende doelstellingen zijn: - Het voldoen aan de huidige wet- en regelgeving - Het borgen van kwaliteit door aan te sturen op kwalitatief optimale dienstverlening (waarbij prestatie-indicatoren zoals efficiency en effectiviteit een rol kunnen spelen). - Bij de conversie dient voldaan te worden aan de regels en richtlijnen vanuit de wetgeving. - Het dient verwerkt te kunnen worden door de bestaande inleesmodule voor gevectoriseerde schetsen in ESRI ArcGIS. Carunan käyttämät helikopteripalvelut sisältävät myrskyn jälkeistä linjatarkastusta, suunniteltuja tarkastuslentoja, lumenpudotusta sekä muita tehtäviä, joissa käytetään helikopteria apuvälineenä. Linjatarkastus ja lumenpudotus on korkeariskistä kaupallista erityislentotoimintaa (High Risk Commercial SPO), joka vaatii operaattorilta voimassa olevat SPO-luvat. Caruna käyttää tarpeen mukaan helikoptereita henkilö- tai materiaalikuljetukseen, joka vaatii operaattorilta AOC-luvan. Caruna suorittaa sähköverkkonsa raivauksia sähköturvallisuuden ja luotettavan sähkönjakelun ylläpitämiseksi. Palvelun tavoite on oksia johtokaduilla, reunavyöhykkeillä sekä niiden vieressä olevaa puustoa, joka ylettyy johtokadulle tai muutoin uhkaa sähkönjakelua. Sähköverkon laserkeilaus ja valokuvaus. Johtokadun leveyden ja sähkönjakelua uhkaavien puiden tutkinta laseraineiston avulla. Palvelun lopputuloksena on kuvausaineisto, josta voidaan tarkastaa sähköverkon kunto.
